name.value: The Wickaninnish Inn - On The Beach

description.value: The Wickaninnish Inn is a celebrated Relais & Châteaux boutique hotel nestled between ancient rainforest and the Pacific Ocean on Chesterman Beach, one of Tofino's most dramatic surf beaches. Built around a philosophy of rustic West Coast elegance, it houses The Pointe Restaurant, Ancient Cedars Spa, and the Henry Nolla Art Gallery, making it a full-destination property. For a touring cyclist completing the Pacific Coast route, it represents a high-end end-of-stage reward with sweeping storm-watch views and on-site fine dining.
